background_hint: Your tunnels keep running when you close this window.
empty_hint: Connect to your WireGuard server in one simple screen.
drop_hint: Have a config or QR image? Drop it anywhere here.
handshake_hint: Waiting for the server. Check its address and public key, and make sure your public key is configured on the server.
setup_hint: Your server address, its public key, and your tunnel address.
hint_name: A name you will recognise. We have filled one in.
hint_addresses: Ask your server administrator. For example, 10.0.0.2/32.
hint_public_key: Share this with your server administrator. It is safe to share.
hint_endpoint: Hostname: DNS SRV discovery. Add :port to override; default 51820.
hint_server_key: The public key supplied by your server administrator.
hint_all_traffic: Send IPv4 and IPv6 traffic through this tunnel.
hint_routes: Networks to reach through the tunnel, separated by commas.
hint_dns: Servers that look up names. Use the DNS addresses from your provider.
hint_psk: Optional extra key from your administrator. Leave blank if none.
hint_psk_set: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or enter - to remove it.
hint_keepalive: Usually blank. Try 25 when behind a router or firewall.
hint_mtu: Packet size. Automatic uses 1420; IPv6 needs at least 1280.
hint_port: Leave blank to let the service choose an available port.
hint_domains: For a split tunnel, names resolved by its DNS, e.g. corp.example.
hint_private_key: Kept in the background service until you choose Show. Never share it.
hint_extra_endpoint: Optional hostname or IP. Omit the port for DNS SRV discovery.
save_hint: We will check the connection with a real handshake.
range_empty: Add a range to see the addresses it covers.
overlap_tunnel: Overlaps “%{name}”. You can save both, but cannot use them together.
overlap_local: This range overlaps your local network. Local devices may become unreachable while connected.
snippet_hint: Give this public snippet to your administrator. Your private key is never included.
language_hint: Choose the language that feels like home.
login_hint: Open quietly in the tray. Tunnels stay off until you connect.
about_hint: A desktop client for WireGuard. Not related to the wg-easy server project.
no_accounts: No accounts. No telemetry. Your settings stay here.
export_confirmation: The file contains your private key. Anyone with it can act as this device. Save it somewhere private. Existing files will not be overwritten.
delete_confirmation: This disconnects the tunnel and removes its settings and keys from this computer.
service_offline: The background service is unavailable. Make sure the app package is installed and the service is running. We will retry automatically.
import_read_error: Could not open that file. Choose a readable config or QR image.
import_too_large: This file is too large. Configs can be up to 256 KiB and images up to 24 MiB.
import_image_error: Could not read that image. Try PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP or TIFF.
qr_not_found: No WireGuard config QR code found. Make sure the entire code is visible and clear.
screen_permission: Screen capture was unavailable. Allow screen recording in system settings, or open the QR image instead.
clipboard_empty: Copy a WireGuard config or a QR image first.
export_done: Config exported. Keep the file private.
export_write_error: Could not save the config. Choose a new filename in a writable folder.
settings_write_error: Could not save this setting. Check access to your user settings folder.
window_error: Could not open the app window. Check that your desktop has a working graphics driver.
error_name: Use a name of 1–80 characters, without control characters.
error_addresses: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address with its prefix, such as 10.0.0.2/32.
error_dns: Enter DNS server IP addresses, separated by commas.
error_domains: Use domain names, such as corp.example, separated by commas.
error_endpoint: Enter a hostname or IP address; use [IPv6]:port for a custom IPv6 port.
error_routes: Enter at least one network range, such as 10.0.0.0/24.
error_key: Use the complete WireGuard key: 44 base64 characters.
error_number: Enter a valid port, keepalive interval, or MTU value.
error_peer_key: Each peer needs a different public key, separate from this device’s key.
error_config: Check the tunnel settings before saving.
conflict: “%{name}” is already using %{other}, which overlaps %{range}. Disconnect it first.
api_validation: Some settings are invalid. Check the highlighted fields and imported config.
api_not_found: This tunnel no longer exists. Refresh the list and try again.
api_conflict: Another active tunnel uses overlapping ranges. Disconnect it first.
api_unauthorized: Your user account is not allowed to control this service. Check the package installation.
api_busy: The tunnel is busy. Disconnect it before editing, then try again.
api_network: The connection could not start. Check the server address and your network.
api_protocol: The app and service versions do not match. Reinstall the same package for both.
api_internal: The service could not complete this action. Restart the service and try again.
api_endpoint: Could not resolve the server address. Check the hostname, DNS SRV records and your network connection.
api_dns: Could not apply DNS. Check the DNS addresses, domain scope and system resolver.
api_permission: The service lacks network permissions. Check its installation and service permissions.
api_driver: The bundled tunnel driver is unavailable. Reinstall the complete app package.
api_recovery: Previous network settings need recovery. Restart the service to restore them.
api_script_hook: Configs with PreUp, PostUp, PreDown or PostDown scripts cannot be imported. Remove the script lines and try again.
api_unsupported_config: This config contains a setting the app cannot safely apply. Remove the unsupported setting and try again.
